title: Assessing the Targeting Efficiency of Clean Water Subsidies Under Uncertainty
Cost‐Benefit Analysis of the European Union Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism in Fertilizer Trade
abstract:
The carbon border adjustment mechanism (CBAM), launching 2026, will charge EU importers for embedded carbon emissions, aiming to reduce emissions but raising import costs. Shifts in demand following implementation may reduce carbon emissions, but importers will bear the cost of increased prices. This study examines and weighs the economic costs and environmental benefits of the CBAM in a fertilizer sector‐specific policy analysis, testing whether the reduction of imported carbon emissions justifies the cost to EU consumers. To evaluate this trade‐off, EU import demand is modeled and analyzed before and after CBAM credits are included in the import price. Economic costs are evaluated through a welfare analysis calculating the decline in surplus due to reduced imports. Environmental benefits are calculated by determining the decreases in fertilizer demand, valued at the social cost of carbon (SCC) to compare directly with economic costs. The baseline scenario results show that the cost of the CBAM, equal to $4.04 billion, outweighs the benefit, equal to $2.58 billion, by $1.46 billion annually, when using a CBAM credit cost of $73.5 per metric ton CO
2
and a SCC value of $254 per metric ton CO
2
. However, sensitivity analysis reveals that the CBAM benefit outweighs the cost when CBAM credits cost $91.8 per metric ton CO
2
or the SCC is valued at $700 per metric ton CO
2
. This study helps relevant stakeholders, as trade partners examine strategies and EU agribusiness prepares for increasing input prices. In light of new EU agricultural goals aimed at reducing synthetic fertilizers, the CBAM's impact on demand for fertilizer imports could provide an opportunity for organic fertilizers as a substitute given policy support.
abstract_zh: 欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）将于 2026 年启动，它将对欧盟进口商征收其进口产品所含隐含碳排放的费用，旨在减少排放，但会推高进口成本。实施后需求的变化可能会减少碳排放，但进口商将承担价格上涨的成本。本研究在化肥行业的特定政策分析中，考察并权衡了 CBAM 的经济成本和环境效益，检验减少进口碳排放是否足以抵偿欧盟消费者所承担的成本。为评估这一权衡，我们对欧盟进口需求在 CBAM 积分计入进口价格前后进行了建模和分析。经济成本通过福利分析进行评估，即计算因进口减少而导致的剩余损失。环境效益则通过测算化肥需求的下降来确定，并按社会碳成本（SCC）进行估值，以便与经济成本直接比较。基准情景的结果表明，当 CBAM 积分成本为每公吨 CO2 73.5 美元、社会碳成本为每公吨 CO2 254 美元时，CBAM 的成本为 40.4 亿美元，超过 25.8 亿美元的效益，每年净损失 14.6 亿美元。然而，敏感性分析表明，当 CBAM 积分成本达到每公吨 CO2 91.8 美元，或社会碳成本估值为每公吨 CO2 700 美元时，CBAM 的效益将超过成本。本研究有助于相关利益方（如贸易伙伴）研究应对策略，也有助于欧盟农业企业为投入品价格上涨做好准备。鉴于欧盟减少合成化肥的新农业目标，在政策支持下，CBAM 对化肥进口需求的影响可能为有机肥作为替代品提供机遇。

title: Do Shifts in Migrant Labour due to COVID ‐19 Affect Climate Change Adaptation Practices of Climate‐Vulnerable Farmers? Implications for the Post‐Pandemic Future
venue: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
abstract: The objective of our study is to examine how migrant labour shifts due to the COVID‐19 pandemic influenced the adaptation behaviour of climate‐vulnerable farmers in Nepal. We examine how the resulting temporary change in climate change adaptation behaviour may be sustainable and improved after migrant labour returns to overseas employment by examining the relationship of institutional factors on climate change adaptation practices. A case study is presented using survey data collected from farmers in the Sunsari district of the eastern plains (Terai) region of Nepal during June 2022. Foreign‐employed migrants were found to have a positive relationship with the adoption of climate change adaptation practices. The finding implies that the presence of migrant household members (younger and more educated) is likely to encourage farmers to adopt more climate change adaptation practices. We further find that improving farmers' access to extension programmes, subsidies and the internet can be potentially used to sustain climate change adaptation practices in the post‐pandemic future. We demonstrate this by estimating the number of climate change adaptation practices by increasing farmers' access to extension programmes and subsidies under post‐pandemic labour scenarios. These estimates provide local policymakers tools to potentially improve accessibility to extension programmes or government subsidies that are likely to enhance farmers' climate change adaptation practices.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在考察 COVID-19 大流行所导致的移民劳动力转移，如何影响尼泊尔气候脆弱农户的适应行为。我们考察了这种因疫情而发生的气候变化适应行为的暂时性变化，在移民劳动力返回海外就业后，是否能够持续并得到改善，并通过考察制度性因素与气候变化适应措施之间的关系进行分析。本文以 2022 年 6 月在尼泊尔东部平原（Terai）地区的 Sunsari 县农户调查数据为案例进行研究。研究发现，在海外就业的移民与采用气候变化适应措施之间存在正向关系。这表明，家庭中年轻且受教育程度较高的移民成员，可能会鼓励农户采用更多的气候变化适应措施。我们还发现，在后疫情时代，改善农户获得推广服务、补贴和互联网的机会，可以用来维持气候变化适应措施。我们通过估计在后疫情劳动力情景下，增加农户获得推广服务和补贴的机会，所能带来的气候变化适应措施数量，对此予以证明。这些估计为地方政策制定者提供了工具，可用于改善推广服务或政府补贴的可及性，从而有望增强农户的气候变化适应行为。

title: Representation of potential species ranges under future climate scenarios by a collaborative conservation plan
abstract: Conservation planning must take into account climate shifts to effectively protect species now and in the future. We analyzed a collaborative conservation priority map for the southeastern United States for its ability to protect species under a range of possible future climates. We used a dataset of ecological niche model predictions calculated for the next 3 decades for 263 forest‐dependent, terrestrial, vertebrate species of conservation concern in the Southern Appalachian region under future climate scenarios from 4 shared socioeconomic pathways. We overlay these predictions with the conservation plan to determine if the priority map successfully represents potential future ranges of forest‐dependent species, that is, locations that are forested, climatically suitable, and reachable. Results show that priority areas for conservation vary in their ability to capture regions predicted to be important for species. Highest and high priority areas perform better than expected from random selection of priority areas at representing regions for all species in our dataset. However, in the context of 2 other conservation strategies, we find highest priority regions could increase representation of regions likely important for geographically rare species. Identification of the areas within the Southeast that are important to species under climate change is necessary to guide future conservation efforts.
abstract_zh: 保护规划必须考虑气候的变化，才能有效地保护当下和未来的物种。我们分析了美国东南部一份协作式保护优先级地图，考察其在一系列可能的未来气候条件下保护物种的能力。我们使用了一个数据集，其中包括为南部阿巴拉契亚地区 263 种关注保护的森林依赖型陆生脊椎动物所作的生态位模型预测，预测范围为未来 30 年，采用了 4 种共享社会经济路径（SSP）下的未来气候情景。我们将这些预测与保护规划叠加，以判断优先级地图能否成功代表森林依赖型物种潜在的未来分布范围，即那些有森林覆盖、气候适宜且可以到达的地点。结果表明，保护优先区域在捕获对物种重要的区域方面的能力存在差异。与随机选择优先区域相比，最高和高优先级区域在代表我们数据集中所有物种的重要区域方面，表现优于预期。然而，与另外两种保护策略相比，我们发现最高优先级区域能够增加对地理上稀有物种的重要区域的代表性。识别东南部在气候变化下对物种具有重要意义的区域，对于指导未来的保护工作十分必要。

title: Internal versus External Innovation: The Role of Competition in Shaping Productivity Returns
Assessing Soil Carbon Sequestration Through Cover Crops: The Role of Implicit Costs in Alabama Cotton Fields
abstract: This study evaluates the economic feasibility of carbon sequestration through cover cropping in Alabama cotton fields, emphasizing the role of implicit costs, proxied by cash rent and reflecting land productivity and market proximity. Using a cost‐efficiency optimization model, we compare carbon supply curves under two cost assumptions: one with explicit costs and another with both explicit and implicit costs. While the carbon supply appears nearly linear with explicit costs alone, adding implicit costs sharply raises sequestration costs, revealing diminishing carbon sequestration efficiency. Spatial analysis highlights regional disparities driven by land values, underscoring the need for targeted, region‐specific policy incentives to strengthen the effectiveness of agricultural carbon markets.
abstract_zh: 本研究评估了阿拉巴马州棉田通过覆盖种植实现碳固存的经济可行性，重点考察了隐性成本的作用，并以地租作为代理变量，反映土地生产力和市场距离。我们采用成本效率优化模型，比较了两种成本假设下的碳供给曲线：一种仅包含显性成本，另一种同时包含显性成本和隐性成本。仅考虑显性成本时，碳供给曲线近似线性；而加入隐性成本后，固碳成本急剧上升，显示出碳固存效率递减。空间分析表明，由于土地价值的差异，各地区存在差异，这凸显了需要有针对性的、因地制宜的政策激励，以增强农业碳市场的有效性。

title: Does more uncertainty incentivize risk diversification in conservation?
abstract: Conservation investments must balance risk and return as the benefits and costs of conservation are becoming increasingly difficult to predict. This article investigates whether a more uncertain world will strengthen the case for conservation investments strategies that diversify risk. We consider two ways the world could be more uncertain: (1) a more uncertain future climate that increases uncertainty in conservation benefits and (2) broader market uncertainties affecting conservation costs. We use concepts from expected utility theory to highlight that, as there is more risk to diversify, the incentive and ability to diversify risk depend on relative changes in expected payoffs at each site and covariances across sites as uncertainty increases. We then illustrate our findings using an application to land protection investments in southern Appalachia. In this biodiversity hotspot, we find risk diversification is most cost‐effective when conservation agencies face multiple uncertainties, and market uncertainty creates greater incentives to diversify risk than climate uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 随着保护效益与成本越来越难以预测，保护投资必须在风险与收益之间取得平衡。本文探讨了一个更加不确定的世界是否会增强采用风险分散化投资策略进行保护的理由。我们考虑了世界可能变得更加不确定的两种方式：（1）未来气候的不确定性增加，从而加大了保护效益的不确定性；（2）更广泛的市场不确定性，影响保护成本。我们运用期望效用理论的概念指出，随着可分散的风险增加，分散风险的动机和能力取决于随着不确定性增加，各地点预期收益的相对变化以及各地点之间的协方差。随后，我们以阿巴拉契亚南部的土地保护投资为应用案例，说明我们的发现。在这一生物多样性热点地区，我们发现，当保护机构面临多重不确定性时，风险分散化最具成本效益；并且，市场不确定性比气候不确定性更能激励人们分散风险。

title: Energy transitions post–Russia–Ukraine war: challenges and policy implications in Germany and Italy
Impact of cost assumptions on forest carbon targets and supply dynamics
Land market feedback from land acquisition influences the prioritization of protected area networks
Social cost of carbon and the potential for forest carbon credits
abstract: This study evaluates the potential of forest carbon credits to mitigate forest-to-urban land conversion in central and southern Appalachia, quantifying credits based on the social costs of carbon under different U.S. administrations. We use a land use model to identify eligible forestland by assessing conversion threats, incorporating geophysical variables and economic returns from forest and urban land uses. Using this data, we forecast areas at risk of conversion and construct a supply curve for forest carbon credits, representing the cost of avoiding forest loss. By intersecting this supply curve with demand informed by social cost of carbon projections from three U.S. administrations, we estimate equilibrium points resulting in between 462 and 743 million tonnes of carbon credits in 2050. While this represents the total potential supply at that future point, it corresponds to 17%-42% of 2022 U.S. annual emissions, providing a benchmark for scale. These credits could generate $229–$571 million in revenues for landowners in 2050, while Trump-era projections suggest only 8.2 million tonnes, yielding $740,000 in landowner revenue. Our findings highlight policy’s role in shaping forest carbon markets and landowners’ incentives. Forest carbon credits could drive regional economic growth and climate mitigation, influencing future U.S. environmental and land use policy.
abstract_zh: 本研究评估了森林碳信用额度缓解阿巴拉契亚中部和南部森林向城市用地转化的潜力，并根据美国不同政府执政时期的社会碳成本来量化碳信用额度。我们使用土地利用模型，通过评估转化威胁、纳入地球物理变量以及森林和城市用地的经济回报，识别符合条件的林地。利用这些数据，我们预测了面临转化风险的区域，并构建了森林碳信用供给曲线，该曲线代表了避免森林损失的成本。通过将该供给曲线与三届美国政府社会碳成本预测所对应的需求相交，我们估计了均衡点，结果显示到 2050 年可产生 4.62 亿至 7.43 亿吨碳信用。尽管这代表了未来该时点的潜在总供给，但其相当于 2022 年美国年度排放量的 17%–42%，为规模提供了基准参照。这些碳信用可在 2050 年为土地所有者带来 2.29 亿至 5.71 亿美元的收入，而特朗普时期的预测则表明仅有 820 万吨，为土地所有者带来 74 万美元的收入。我们的研究结果凸显了政策在塑造森林碳市场及土地所有者激励方面的作用。森林碳信用可以推动区域经济增长和气候减缓，并影响未来美国的环境和土地利用政策。

title: Innovation under Pressure: How Competition Shapes the Productivity Impact of Internal and External R&D
Risk tolerance towards research and development investment: the role of firm size and technology intensity
Examining how risk diversification for conservation is influenced by the probability assigned to uncertainty scenarios
abstract: Despite the progress in conservation risk management, conservation organizations are reluctant to interface usable risk-diversification strategies with their decision-making processes. One reason for this reluctance is that the empirical models used to develop risk-diversification strategies need the expected returns on investment (ROIs) of target assets and their variances and covariances, and the probabilities of occurrence of the scenarios needed to calculate those statistics are almost always unknown. We examine how risk diversification for conservation is influenced by the probabilities assigned to uncertainty scenarios using a case study involving the conservation of biodiversity at the county level in the central and southern Appalachian region within the framework of modern portfolio theory. A comparison of risk-mitigating portfolios with bootstrapped and fixed probability distributions shows that introducing the flexibility of an unknown probability distribution of uncertainty scenarios allows conservation organizations to spread bets more than with the inflexibility of the fixed probability distribution, while also achieving higher expected ROIs per unit of risk on average. The improvement becomes more significant when conservation organizations are less risk averse.
abstract_zh: 尽管保护风险管理已取得进展，但保护组织仍不愿将可用的风险分散策略纳入其决策过程。其中一个原因是，用于制定风险分散策略的实证模型需要目标资产的预期投资回报率（ROI）及其方差和协方差，而计算这些统计量所需的情景发生概率几乎总是未知的。本研究以阿巴拉契亚中部和南部县级生物多样性保护为案例，在现代投资组合理论框架下，考察了分配给不确定性情景的概率如何影响保护的风险分散。通过比较基于自助法（bootstrapped）和固定概率分布的风险缓释组合，我们发现，引入对不确定性情景未知概率分布的灵活性，相比于固定概率分布的僵化假设，能使保护组织更加分散其投资，同时平均而言每单位风险获得更高的预期投资回报率。当保护组织的风险厌恶程度较低时，这种改进更为显著。

title: Factors affecting adoption intensity of climate change adaptation practices: A case of smallholder rice producers in Chitwan, Nepal
abstract: This study examines how smallholder rice producers' adoption intensity for climate change adaptation practices (i.e., improved varieties, irrigation practices, direct seeded rice, integrated pest management, and adjustment in crop calendar) is influenced by access to Extension services, training, weather-related information, and membership in farmer groups or cooperatives (referred to as “institutional resources”). We use survey data collected from 359 smallholder rice producers in the Chitwan district of Nepal in 2019. The results indicate that: (1) access to institutional resources significantly enhance the likelihood of adoption of more climate change adaptation practices; (2) high intensity climate change adaptation practice measured by the adoption of three, four, and five practices significantly increases with access to institutional resources; (3) intensity of adoption of climate change adaptation practices is reduced with greater adaptation alternatives available to rice producers; and (4) lack of information and technical knowledge are the most important reasons for non-adoption of climate change adaptation practices by smallholder rice producers. The results are valuable for policy makers and planners to prioritize training opportunities and allocate scarce resources to enhance climate change adaptation and improve sustainability of rice production practices.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了小农水稻生产者采用气候变化适应措施的强度（包括改良品种、灌溉措施、直播水稻、病虫害综合治理以及调整种植日历）如何受到推广服务的获取、培训、天气相关信息，以及参与农民团体或合作社（统称为“制度资源”）的影响。我们使用了 2019 年在尼泊尔奇旺（Chitwan）县对 359 名小农水稻生产者的调查数据。结果表明：（1）获得制度资源显著提高了采用更多气候变化适应措施的可能性；（2）采用三种、四种和五种措施的高强度气候变化适应行为，随着制度资源的获取而显著增加；（3）随着水稻生产者可选择的适应替代方案增多，气候变化适应措施的采用强度反而降低；（4）缺乏信息和技术知识，是小农水稻生产者不采用气候变化适应措施的最重要原因。研究结果对政策制定者和规划者具有参考价值，有助于他们优先安排培训机会，并配置稀缺资源，以加强气候变化适应，提高水稻生产的可持续性。

title: How risk-diversification for conservation investment is affected by the real estate market shock triggered by the COVID-19 pandemic
abstract: Real-estate prices have soared since the start of the COVID-19 pandemic amid historically low mortgage rates and limited supply. The external shock observed in the real-estate market through relief measures may trigger changes in optimal conservation portfolios. The objective of this research is to identify the impacts of the real-estate market shock triggered by the pandemic through low-interest rates and limited real-estate supply on risk-diversification strategies for land conservation investment and to understand the implications of these impacts. We use a case study involving biodiversity conservation in the central and southern Appalachian region of the US by comparing modern portfolio theory (MPT) outputs using future conservation cost predictions with and without the shock. We find that the financial burden to fund the same level of risk-diversifying conservation benefits increases due to the shock and increases at an increasing rate as the return on investment (ROI) objective rises. This finding is alarming since higher conservation costs triggered by the shock decrease the cost-effectiveness of risk diversification, and this effect exacerbates with the goal of achieving higher ROI. Spatial diversification strategies with and without the shock offer risk-diversification information to help conservation organizations determine effective investment strategies.
abstract_zh: 自 COVID-19 大流行开始以来，在历史低位抵押贷款利率和有限供给的背景下，房地产价格大幅上涨。通过救助措施在房地产市场中显现的外部冲击，可能会改变最优的保护投资组合。本研究的目的在于，识别疫情所引发的、通过低利率和有限房地产供给而产生的房地产市场冲击，对土地保护投资风险分散策略的影响，并理解这些影响的含义。我们以美国阿巴拉契亚中部和南部的生物多样性保护为案例，通过比较现代投资组合理论（MPT）在包含和不包含该冲击的未来保护成本预测下的结果进行研究。我们发现，由于该冲击，为资助同等水平的风险分散保护效益所需的财务负担有所增加，并且随着投资回报率（ROI）目标的提高，这种增加速度也在加快。这一发现令人担忧，因为冲击所导致的更高保护成本降低了风险分散的成本效益，并且随着提高投资回报率目标，这一效应会加剧。在包含和不包含该冲击的情形下，空间分散策略都为保护组织提供了风险分散信息，有助于其确定有效的投资策略。

title: Is the discovery of oil a blessing or curse in the era of climate change?
Biodiversity conservation adaptation to climate change: Protecting the actors or the stage
abstract: To be able to protect biodiversity in coming decades, conservation strategies need to consider what sites will be important for species not just today but also in the future. Different methods have been proposed to identify places that will be important for species in the future. Two of the most frequently used methods, ecological niche modeling and climate resilience, have distinct aims. The former focuses on identifying the suitable environmental conditions for species, thus protecting the “actor,” namely, the species, whereas the latter seeks to safeguard the “stage,” or the landscape in which species occur. We used the two methods to identify climate refugia for 258 forest vertebrates under short‐ and long‐term climatic changes in a biodiversity hotspot, the Appalachian ecoregion of the United States. We also evaluated the spatial congruence of the two approaches for a possible conservation application, that of protecting 30% of the Appalachian region, in line with recent national and international policy recommendations. We detected weak positive correlations between resilience scores and baseline vertebrate richness, estimated with ecological niche models for historical (baseline) climatic conditions. The correlations were stronger for amphibians and mammals than for birds and reptiles. Under climate change scenarios, the correlations between estimated vertebrate richness and resilience were also weakly positive; a positive correlation was detected only for amphibians. Locations with estimated future gain of suitable climatic conditions for vertebrates showed low correlation with resilience. Overall, our results indicate that climate resilience and ecological niche modeling approaches capture different characteristics of projected distributional changes of Appalachian vertebrates. A climate resilience (the stage) approach could be more effective in safeguarding species with low dispersal abilities, whereas an ecological niche modeling (the actor) approach could be more suitable for species with long‐distance dispersal capacity because they may be more broadly impacted by climate and less sensitive to geophysical features captured by a climate resilience approach.
abstract_zh: 为了在未来几十年保护生物多样性，保护策略需要考虑哪些地点不仅对今天的物种重要，也对未来的物种重要。已有多种方法被提出，用于识别未来对物种具有重要意义的地点。其中最常用的两种方法——生态位建模和气候韧性——目标各不相同。前者侧重于识别物种适宜的环境条件，从而保护“行动者”（即物种本身）；而后者则致力于保护“舞台”，即物种所在的景观。我们在美国阿巴拉契亚生态区这一生物多样性热点地区，运用这两种方法，识别了 258 种森林脊椎动物在短期和长期气候变化下的气候避难所（climate refugia）。我们还评估了两种方法在一项可能的保护应用中的空间一致性，即依照近期国家和国际政策建议，保护阿巴拉契亚地区 30% 的区域。我们发现，韧性得分与基线脊椎动物丰富度（由历史（基线）气候条件下的生态位模型估计）之间存在弱正相关。两栖类和哺乳类的相关性强于鸟类和爬行类。在气候变化情景下，估计的脊椎动物丰富度与韧性之间的相关性同样呈弱正相关；仅在两栖类中检测到正相关。预计未来脊椎动物适宜气候条件增加的地点，与韧性之间的相关性较低。总体而言，我们的结果表明，气候韧性和生态位建模方法捕捉了阿巴拉契亚脊椎动物预计分布变化的不同特征。对于扩散能力较低的物种，气候韧性（舞台）方法可能更有效地保护；而对于具有长距离扩散能力的物种，生态位建模（行动者）方法可能更为适宜，因为这些物种可能受气候的影响更为广泛，对气候韧性方法所捕捉的地球物理特征不那么敏感。

title: Creating portfolios of firm-specific energy R&D investment under market uncertainty
abstract: This research determines the optimal distribution of firm-specific energy research and development (R&D) investment that balances firms’ return and risk under market-induced uncertainty. We focus on creating optimal portfolios of target firms and their optimal energy R&D investments that maximize their return on investments (ROIs) for given levels of risk. We employ a stochastic optimization framework that maximizes firms’ ROIs for energy R&D investment, measured by the ratio of the number of patents issued for energy technologies to the amount of annual energy R&D expenditures, for 78 energy firms in South Korea between 2006 and 2017. The findings from our mean-standard deviation tradeoff frontiers are summarized as follows: 1) the tradeoff ratio increases as the weights shift from 100% on maximizing expected ROI toward 100% on minimizing its standard deviation regardless of market conditions and 2) the tradeoff ratio during the downturn is higher than during the upturn. These findings suggest that firms mitigate market-induced risk with a smaller sacrifice in the expected number of issued patents when the initial weight is primarily on maximizing expected ROIs and when the market is experiencing an upturn instead of a downturn. From the distribution patterns of prioritized firms for the two extreme risk preference points along the upturn and downturn tradeoff frontiers, we find that the target firms shift under different market conditions and risk assumptions. These priority shifts highlight the importance of decision-maker flexibility in structuring firms’ portfolios to support energy R&D, depending on the governments’ risk tolerances and market conditions.
abstract_zh: 本研究确定了企业特定能源研发（R&D）投资的最优分配，以在市场诱发的不确定性下平衡企业的收益与风险。我们关注如何构建目标企业的最优组合及其最优能源研发投资，以在给定风险水平下使其投资回报率（ROI）最大化。我们采用随机优化框架，以能源技术获得的专利数量与年度能源研发支出之比来衡量能源研发投资的投资回报率，并以韩国 2006 年至 2017 年间的 78 家能源企业为样本，实现企业投资回报率的最大化。我们的均值—标准差权衡前沿的主要发现如下：1）权重从 100% 最大化预期投资回报率转向 100% 最小化其标准差时，无论市场状况如何，权衡比率均会上升；2）经济下行期间的权衡比率高于经济上行期间。这些发现表明，当最初的权重主要放在最大化预期投资回报率上，并且市场处于上行而非下行时，企业可以用较小的预期专利产出牺牲来降低市场诱发的风险。从上行和下行权衡前沿上两个极端风险偏好点的优先企业分布来看，我们发现目标企业在不同的市场条件和风险假设下会发生变化。这些优先级的转变凸显了决策者灵活性的重要性，即根据政府的风险承受能力和市场条件来构建企业组合，以支持能源研发。

title: Does a trade-off exist between economic and environmental impacts of forest carbon payment programs?
Examining complementary relationships among climate change adaptation practices of rice producers in Chitwan, Nepal
abstract: This study examines how the complementary relationships among multiple climate change adaptation strategies (improved varieties, irrigation practices and direct-seeded rice, referred to as ‘DSR’) are influenced by access to Extension services, training related to farming practices and weather-related information (referred to as ‘institutional factors’). This study hypothesizes the influence of institutional factors and the resulting effects on their joint adoption using survey data collected from 359 rice producers in Chitwan district of Nepal in 2019. The results indicate: (1) adoption of all the three climate change adaptation practices are complementary to each other; (2) all three institutional factors enhance the likelihood of the adoption of variety, access to Extension and training enhances the likelihood of the adoption of improved irrigation, and information enhances the likelihood of the adoption of DSR and (3) access to Extension and training enhance the complementarities among all three pairs of adaptation practices (variety and irrigation; variety and DSR and irrigation and DSR), while information enhances the complementarity between variety and DSR only. The impact of complementary relationships among multiple climate change adaptation strategies influenced by the institutional factors is particularly valuable for policy makers and government agencies to allocate and prioritize resources.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了多种气候变化适应策略（改良品种、灌溉措施以及直播水稻，简称“DSR”）之间的互补关系，如何受到推广服务的获取、与农业实践相关的培训以及天气相关信息（统称为“制度性因素”）的影响。本研究假设了制度性因素的影响，及其对这些适应措施联合采用的效应，并使用了 2019 年在尼泊尔奇旺县对 359 名水稻生产者的调查数据。结果表明：（1）三种气候变化适应措施的采用彼此互补；（2）三种制度性因素均提高了采用品种的可能性，推广服务和培训的获取提高了采用改进灌溉的可能性，而信息则提高了采用直播水稻的可能性；（3）推广服务和培训的获取，增强了三对适应措施之间的互补性（品种与灌溉、品种与直播水稻，以及灌溉与直播水稻），而信息仅增强了品种与直播水稻之间的互补性。制度性因素影响下多种气候变化适应策略之间的互补关系，对于政策制定者和政府机构分配和确定资源优先顺序具有特别重要的价值。

title: Identifying optimal financial budget distributions for the low-carbon energy transition between emerging and developed countries
Spatial and taxonomic diversification for conservation investment under uncertainty
abstract: Conservation organizations often need to develop risk-diversification strategies that identify not just what species to protect but also where to protect them. The objective of this research is to identify optimal conservation investment allocations for both target sites and species under conditions of uncertainty. We develop a two-step approach using modern portfolio theory (MPT) to estimate percentages of conservation investment (referred to as ‘portfolio weights’) for counties and taxonomic groups in the central and southern Appalachian region under climate and market uncertainties. The portfolio weights across the counties and taxonomic groups from the two steps entail both spatial and taxonomic diversification strategies. Conservation decisions that allow for selecting sites for risk diversification fit the purpose of the first step. Likewise, conservation investments that benefit the biodiversity of particular taxonomic groups for the selected sites are made based on the relative importance of diversifying risk among species in a given area, fitting the purpose of the second step. The two-step MPT approach as a whole allows the greatest flexibility on where and what to protect for conservation investment under uncertainty, and thus would be applicable for the distribution of general conservation funds without predisposition towards protecting either specific sites or species.
abstract_zh: 保护组织通常需要制定风险分散策略，以确定不仅要保护哪些物种，还要在哪里进行保护。本研究的目标是在不确定性条件下，为目标地点和物种确定最优的保护投资分配。我们采用现代投资组合理论（MPT）开发了一种两步法，用于估计阿巴拉契亚中部和南部地区在气候和市场不确定性下，县和分类群的保护投资百分比（称为“组合权重”）。两步得出的跨县和跨分类群的组合权重，同时体现了空间和分类层面的分散策略。第一步旨在支持保护决策，即为风险分散选择地点。同样，第二步则根据特定区域内各物种之间风险分散的相对重要性，决定为所选地点中某一分类群的生物多样性做出的保护投资。整个两步 MPT 方法在不确定性下，为保护投资选择保护的地点和对象提供了最大的灵活性，因此适用于一般保护资金的分配，而无需预先偏向于保护特定地点或物种。

title: Understanding the differences between single‐ and multiobjective optimization for the conservation of multiple species
abstract: The purpose of this study is to understand how solutions from single‐ and multiobjective optimization for the conservation of multiple species are different and what impacts these differences. We identify optimal conservation investment allocations maximizing expected species' habitat ranges for multiple pairs of species using two approaches in the central and southern Appalachian region. We find that disparities between the two approaches are affected by differences in the involved species' expected habitat ranges (i.e., contrasting and similar) and their correlation pattern (i.e., positive, negative, and insignificant). Using a single metric by aggregating species' habitats for multiple species to carry out single‐objective optimization is shown to favor the species with a larger habitat distribution more if the involved species' expected habitat distributions are negatively correlated and their distribution difference is larger. Framing multiple metrics of species' habitats separately using multiobjective optimization for the same set of multiple species, in contrast, does not show such a drastic disparity.
abstract_zh: 本研究的目的是理解在多物种保护中，单目标优化与多目标优化所得出的解有何不同，以及这些差异产生了何种影响。我们在阿巴拉契亚中部和南部地区，采用两种方法，针对多对物种，求解使其预期栖息地范围最大化的最优保护投资分配。我们发现，两种方法之间的差异受到所涉物种预期栖息地范围（即差异较大或相似）及其相关模式（即正相关、负相关或不显著相关）的影响。将多个物种的栖息地汇总为单一指标进行单目标优化，若所涉物种的预期栖息地分布呈负相关，且分布差异较大，则会更偏向于栖息地分布较大的物种。相比之下，对同一组物种的栖息地分别采用多目标优化、以多个指标分别进行框架设定，则未表现出如此明显的差异。

title: Impact of the rise of solo living and an ageing population on residential energy consumption in South Korea
abstract: Demographic changes have a profound impact on residential energy consumption. The number of single-person households is rapidly increasing around the world and the percentages of elderly individuals in the populations of almost all countries are expanding. The objective of our research was to analyze how single-person households and elderly households impact residential energy intensity, defined as annual residential energy consumption per capita per unit of finished area of the household’s house, and how those impacts interact with each other using South Korea as a case study. Our findings suggest that the rise of solo living and an ageing population have overlapping effects on energy consumption and threaten future improvements in residential energy intensity. Specifically, an increase of single-person households results in a decline in energy intensity regardless of whether the household is elderly or non-elderly and the effect of an increase in elderly households on energy intensity depends on whether the household is single- or multiple-person. Given the similar average size of finished area for single-person households, the difference in per unit energy consumption between elderly versus non-elderly households likely comes from behavioral differences such as a greater use of energy-intensive appliances by non-elderly households than elderly households. However, for multiple-person households, the effect of such behavioral differences seems to be dominated by the effect of a house’s shared amenities. The common space and energy-consuming amenities of a house are shared by more individuals in non-elderly households, leading to more intensive energy consumption by non-elderly multiple-person households than by elderly multiple-person households.
abstract_zh: 人口结构变化对居民能源消费有深远影响。全球单人家庭数量迅速增加，几乎所有国家人口中的老年人比例都在上升。本研究以韩国为案例，旨在分析单人家庭和老年家庭如何影响居民能源强度（定义为单位居住面积上的人均年居民能源消费量），以及这两类影响如何相互作用。研究发现，独居化与人口老龄化对能源消费的影响相互交织，并可能削弱未来居民能源强度的改善。具体而言，单人家庭的增加会导致能源强度下降，无论该家庭是否为老年家庭；而老年家庭增加对能源强度的影响则取决于其是单人家庭还是多人家庭。鉴于单人家庭的平均居住面积大致相当，老年家庭与非老年家庭之间单位能源消费的差异，很可能来自行为差异，例如非老年家庭比老年家庭更多地使用高耗能电器。然而，对于多人家庭而言，这种行为差异的影响似乎被住宅公共设施的效应所主导。非老年多人家庭的公共空间和高耗能设施由更多人共享，因此其能源消费强度高于老年多人家庭。

title: Impacts of Ambient Air Pollution on Health Risk in Korea: A Spatial Panel Model Assessment
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of air quality pollution on respiratory health risk in Korea. In particular, we consider transboundary effects of particulate matter (PM10) on the health risk of pneumonia by using the spatial panel model. PM10, generated by natural phenomena and anthropogenic activities, migrates to neighboring areas contributing to not only local but also ambient regional health risks. We employ the spatial panel model to explain the spillover effects of air pollution on the respiratory health risk. The panel data covers environmental, demographic and economic variables that are associated with pneumonia of 120 local districts in Korea during the period from 2010 to 2015. Empirical evidence based on non-spatial and spatial models commonly indicates that the impact of air pollution on pneumonia-related risk is significant. The spatial panel model assessment reveals improvement in explanation and evidences more significant effect of ambient air pollution on pneumonia related hospital visits. As such, evidences of spatial dependence and borderless impacts of air pollution on the health risk of pneumonia are found to be strong. We also investigate the spatial dynamics of the potential association between air pollution and respiratory diseases with respect to variations in wind direction by extending the conventional weight matrix specification. Empirical results imply that transboundary effects of PM10 on health risk are stronger for districts located downwind from Northwest districts than from other directions.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了空气质量污染对韩国呼吸道健康风险的影响。具体而言，我们利用空间面板模型，考察可吸入颗粒物（PM10）的跨界效应对肺炎健康风险的影响。PM10既来源于自然现象，也来源于人类活动，会向邻近地区扩散，不仅造成本地健康风险，也造成区域性的健康风险。我们采用空间面板模型来解释空气污染对呼吸道健康风险的溢出效应。面板数据涵盖2010年至2015年韩国120个地方行政区与肺炎相关的环境、人口和经济变量。基于非空间模型和空间模型的实证证据普遍表明，空气污染对肺炎相关风险具有显著影响。空间面板模型评估显示，其解释力有所提高，并证明环境空气污染对肺炎相关的医院就诊具有更显著的影响。因此，空间依赖性以及空气污染对肺炎健康风险的无边界影响得到了有力证据支持。我们还通过扩展传统的权重矩阵设定，考察了空气污染与呼吸道疾病之间潜在关联随风向变化的空间动态。实证结果表明，对于位于西北部地区下风向的行政区，PM10对健康风险的跨界效应强于其他方向。

title: Role of complementary and competitive relationships among multiple objectives in conservation investment decisions
Understanding how opportunity cost affects multi-objective conservation investment in the Central and Southern Appalachian Region (USA)
abstract: Consensus does not exist for which cost forms (i.e., one accounting solely for explicit cost and the other for both explicit and opportunity costs as in relative opportunity cost) are used in calculating return on investment (ROI) for conservation-related decisions. This research examines how the cost of conservation investment with and without inclusion of the opportunity cost of the protected area results in different solutions in a multi-objective optimization framework at the county level in the Central and Southern Appalachian Region of the USA. We maximize rates of ROI of both forest-dependent biodiversity and economic impact generated by forest-based payments for ecosystem services. We find that the conservation budget is optimally distributed more narrowly among counties that are more likely to be rural when the investment cost measure is relative opportunity cost than when it is explicit cost. We also find that the sacrifice in forest-dependent biodiversity per unit increase in economic impact is higher when investment cost is measured by relative opportunity cost rather than when measured by explicit cost. By understanding the consequences of using one cost measure over the other, a conservation agency can decide on which cost measure is more appropriate for informing the agency’s decision-making process.
abstract_zh: 对于在保护相关决策中应采用哪种成本形式计算投资回报率（ROI）——即仅考虑显性成本，还是同时考虑显性成本与机会成本（如相对机会成本）——学界尚无共识。本研究在多目标优化框架下，以美国中南部阿巴拉契亚地区的县为单位，考察在计算保护投资成本时是否纳入保护区的机会成本，如何导致不同的最优解。我们同时最大化森林依赖型生物多样性的投资回报率，以及森林生态系统服务付费所产生的经济影响。研究发现，当投资成本以相对机会成本衡量时，保护预算在更可能为农村的县之间的最优分配更为集中，而以显性成本衡量时则不然。我们还发现，当投资成本以相对机会成本衡量时，经济影响每增加一单位所牺牲的森林依赖型生物多样性更高，而以显性成本衡量时则较低。通过理解采用不同成本衡量方式所产生的后果，保护管理机构可以判断哪种成本衡量方式更适合为其决策过程提供依据。

title: Where and When Carbon Storage can be Bought Cost Effectively from Private Forest Owners
Deriving site-specific and time-varying supply curves for forest carbon storage
venue: Journal of Environmental Planning and Management
abstract: We examine whether site-specific and time-varying supply functions for environmental benefits can be used to improve the design of conservation programs. We derive time-varying supply curves for site-specific forest carbon storage at the one-km2 pixel level for three periods for the southern Appalachian region of the United States. We couple a land use model with a carbon simulation model to estimate the opportunity cost of sequestering forest carbon and derive supply curves for forest carbon storage for the three periods. Our study derives a large number of annual supply curves for site-specific forest carbon storage across multiple periods. Our approach signifies the value of identifying cost-effective approaches at a fine enough scale to account for the information asymmetry between private landowner costs and their benefits from potential land uses. The temporal aspect of our findings raise important questions about temporal flexibilities of payment designs with regard to their spatial targeting.
abstract_zh: 本文考察针对特定地点且随时间变化的环境效益供给函数能否用于改进保护计划的设计。我们以美国南部阿巴拉契亚地区为例，在1平方公里像元层面，推导了三个时期内特定地点森林碳储量的时变供给曲线。我们将土地利用模型与碳模拟模型相结合，估算森林碳封存的机会成本，并推导出三个时期的森林碳储量供给曲线。本研究在多个时期内推导出大量特定地点森林碳储量的年度供给曲线。我们的方法表明，有必要在足够精细的尺度上识别具有成本效益的途径，以考虑私人土地所有者成本与其潜在土地用途收益之间的信息不对称。研究结果的时间维度提出了一个重要问题：支付设计在空间瞄准方面是否具有时间上的灵活性。

title: Do ecological–economic tradeoffs triggered by budget allocations for forest carbon sequestration change under different market conditions?
Estimating the uncertainty–R&D investment relationship and its interactions with firm size
Optimal Budget Allocations for Protected Area Acquisition To Store Carbon in a Local Community Under Economic Growth Uncertainty
abstract: We analyze optimal budget allocations to acquire protected areas for carbon storage while balancing risk and return from protection under economic growth uncertainty in a local community. Our study is the first to explore how risk of uncertain economic growth affects cost of protected area acquisition using real estate values at the parcel level, enabling us to estimate the site-specific opportunity cost of carbon storage. The Pareto optimal trade-off frontier between the expected carbon storage benefit and its variance provides a continuum of risk-return combinations. The pattern of the trade-off relationship implies that risk mitigation is less costly in terms of foregone expected benefit when risk is higher than when it is lower. Our results also find that the difference in cluster-specific budget allocations between the strong economic growth scenario and the weak economic growth scenario subsequently decreases between the point of expected benefit maximization and the point of variance minimization. Our findings of optimal hectares of land for protected area acquisition for carbon storage and corresponding benefits and costs serve as an empirically informed knowledge base to help a local community prioritize acquisition of potential protected areas for carbon storage under economic growth uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了地方社区在经济增长不确定性下，为碳储存而收购保护区时，如何在平衡保护的风险与收益的前提下实现最优预算配置。本研究首次利用地块层面的房地产价格，探讨经济增长的不确定性风险如何影响保护区收购成本，从而使我们能够估算特定地点碳储存的机会成本。预期碳储存收益与其方差之间的帕累托最优权衡前沿，提供了一系列连续的风险-收益组合。该权衡关系的形态表明，当风险较高时，降低风险所损失的预期收益比风险较低时更小。我们的结果还发现，强经济增长情景与弱经济增长情景下各聚类的预算配置差异，在预期收益最大化点与方差最小化点之间逐步缩小。我们关于碳储存保护区最优收购面积及相应收益与成本的发现，为地方社区在经济增长不确定性下优先确定潜在碳储存保护区提供了基于实证的知识基础。

abstract: The objective of this research was to identify optimal spatial targeting and distributions of a fixed PES (payment systems for ecosystem services) budget that achieves the three objectives of maximizing forest‐based carbon storage to improve cost efficiency, maximizing poverty alleviation to promote equity, and maximizing economic impact to encourage economic development. We used the Central and Southern Appalachian Region as a case study to develop a county‐level framework for identifying optimal county targets and optimal budget allocations for forest‐based carbon sequestration that addresses the three objectives. The results show that optimal budgets are more geographically widespread under the multiple‐objective priority scenarios than under the single‐objective of maximizing carbon cost efficiency, and the optimal spatial distributions of the four priority scenarios do not change appreciably across priority scenarios. The quantified relationships reveal that different priority weights among the priority scenarios yield both competitive trade‐offs and synergistic relationships between the objectives.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在确定一项固定的生态系统服务付费（PES）预算的最优空间瞄准方案与分配方式，以实现三个目标：最大化基于森林的碳储存以提高成本效率，最大化扶贫以促进公平，以及最大化经济影响以促进经济发展。我们以美国中南部阿巴拉契亚地区为案例，建立了县级框架，用于识别最优目标县和基于森林的碳封存最优预算分配方案，以兼顾三个目标。结果表明，与仅以最大化碳成本效率为单一目标的情景相比，多目标优先情景下的最优预算在地理上分布更广；而且，四种优先情景的最优空间分布在不同情景之间并无明显变化。量化关系显示，各优先情景之间不同的优先权重，既会产生目标之间的竞争性权衡，也会产生协同关系。

title: Targeting payments for forest carbon sequestration given ecological and economic objectives
Using portfolio theory in spatial targeting of forest carbon payments: an effective strategy to address spatiotemporal variation in land-use opportunity costs?
abstract: The objective of our research is to extend current conservation applications of modern portfolio theory (MPT) to develop a framework for the cost-efficient budget distribution for a forest carbon payment program that optimizes risk–reward trade-offs in the presence of economic growth uncertainty over time. We consider correlation across space and time of the fluctuating opportunity costs of restoring forestland under changing future economic conditions using a case study of eight states in the central and southern Appalachian region of the United States. The findings suggest that optimal budget allocation decisions that ignore the covariance component of the spatial variance–covariance structure of forest carbon returns fail to minimize the true risk of conservation investment for any level of expected return. The importance of incorporating the spatial covariance in targeting conservation payments is made explicit through alternative approaches using multi-objective (mean–variance) optimization and an ex post analysis with and without the covariance component of the spatial variance–covariance structure of forest carbon return on investment (ROI). A comparison of these approaches against our MPT-based approach revealed misleading risk–return expectations if the ROI covariance is ignored in the spatial targeting of forest carbon payments under uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在将现代投资组合理论（MPT）在保护领域的现有应用加以拓展，构建一个框架，用于在经济增长随时间变化不确定的情况下，为森林碳付费项目进行具有成本效率的预算分配，以优化风险与收益之间的权衡。我们以美国中南部阿巴拉契亚地区的八个州为案例，考虑了在未来经济条件变化下，恢复林地的波动机会成本在空间和时间上的相关性。研究结果表明，若忽略森林碳收益空间方差-协方差结构中的协方差成分，则基于此的最优预算分配决策无法在任何预期收益水平下将保护投资的真实风险降至最低。通过多目标（均值-方差）优化方法，以及有无协方差成分的事后分析（针对森林碳投资回报率的空间方差-协方差结构），我们明确地说明了在保护付费的目标瞄准中纳入空间协方差的重要性。将这些方法与我们基于MPT的方法进行比较后发现，如果在不确定条件下的森林碳付费空间瞄准中忽略了投资回报率的协方差，就会产生误导性的风险-收益预期。

Evaluating a tax-based subsidy approach for forest carbon sequestration
abstract: Forest carbon sequestration plays an important role in reducing the build-up of greenhouse gases that are known to contribute to global climate change. However, private landowners will supply less carbon sequestration than would be socially desirable if they are unable to capture the economic value of sequestration. We examine the viability of offering landowners property tax subsidies for forest carbon sequestration (referred to as a ‘tax-based subsidy approach’). Waiving property taxes on forestland provides incentives for landowners to afforest non-forested land and/or sustain forests that are at risk of deforestation. We focus on 17 Tennessee counties and one Kentucky county, constituting one of 179 Bureau of Economic Analysis areas in the United States, as a case study. Higher forestland net return from waiving property taxes increases the share of forestland in the 18 counties, which in turn increases the accumulation of carbon in the forest ecosystem, suggesting that this is a viable approach. The annualized county-level cost of supplying forest carbon sequestration using a tax-based subsidy ranges between US$15.56 and US$563.58 per carbon tonne across the 18 counties. Relevant government agencies can use these estimates to target selected counties for more cost-effective adoption of the county-level tax-based subsidy approach.
abstract_zh: 森林碳封存在减少温室气体积累方面发挥着重要作用，而温室气体积累已被证实是全球气候变化的成因之一。然而，如果私人土地所有者无法获取碳封存的经济价值，其提供的碳封存量将低于社会期望水平。本文考察了为森林碳封存向土地所有者提供财产税补贴（称为“基于税收的补贴方式”）的可行性。免征林地财产税可激励土地所有者在非林地上造林，和/或维持面临砍伐风险的森林。我们以田纳西州17个县和肯塔基州1个县为案例研究，这些县构成美国179个经济分析局（BEA）区域之一。免征财产税所带来的林地净收益提高，增加了这18个县中林地的占比，进而增加了森林生态系统中的碳积累，表明这是一种可行的方法。利用基于税收的补贴提供森林碳封存的县级年化成本，在这18个县之间介于每吨碳15.56美元至563.58美元之间。相关政府机构可利用这些估计值，选择目标县，以更具成本效益地采用县级基于税收的补贴方式。

title: Factoring economic costs into conservation planning may not improve agreement over priorities for protection
abstract: Conservation organizations must redouble efforts to protect habitat given continuing biodiversity declines. Prioritization of future areas for protection is hampered by disagreements over what the ecological targets of conservation should be. Here we test the claim that such disagreements will become less important as conservation moves away from prioritizing areas for protection based only on ecological considerations and accounts for varying costs of protection using return-on-investment (ROI) methods. We combine a simulation approach with a case study of forests in the eastern United States, paying particular attention to how covariation between ecological benefits and economic costs influences agreement levels. For many conservation goals, agreement over spatial priorities improves with ROI methods. However, we also show that a reliance on ROI-based prioritization can sometimes exacerbate disagreements over priorities. As such, accounting for costs in conservation planning does not enable society to sidestep careful consideration of the ecological goals of conservation.
abstract_zh: 鉴于生物多样性持续下降，保护机构必须加倍努力保护栖息地。由于对保护的生态目标应为何种目标存在分歧，未来保护优先区域的确定受到阻碍。本文检验了如下论断：当保护工作不再仅基于生态考虑来确定优先保护区域，而是采用投资回报率（ROI）方法来考虑不同保护成本时，此类分歧将变得不那么重要。我们将模拟方法与美国东部森林案例研究相结合，特别关注生态效益与经济成本之间的协变关系如何影响一致性水平。对于许多保护目标而言，采用投资回报率方法能提高对空间优先次序的一致性。然而，我们也表明，依赖基于投资回报率的优先排序有时反而会加剧对优先次序的分歧。因此，在保护规划中考虑成本，并不能让社会回避对保护生态目标的审慎考量。

title: Effects of changes in electricity price on electricity demand and resulting effects on manufacturing output
abstract: Many countries are interested in reducing electricity consumption in connection with that the electricity demand has been increasing in recent years. Price control is often used as a method of controlling electricity demand in the short-term. However, even if price control causes to decrease in electricity use, the decrease in electricity demand results in a decrease in economic activity as electricity use plays a role in one of input factors. In this respect, this research analyze how changes in electricity price influence electricity demand, and how subsequent changes in electricity demand change production of manufacturing output, focusing particularly on how these relationships change over space. In this paper, we use the simultaneous equation based on Generalized spatial two-stage least squares model (GS2SLS) to examine the interrelationship among electricity demand, economic output, and electricity price. By assessing these relationships in one modeling framework, we evaluate electricity-price scenarios to help policymakers about electricity price decisions.
abstract_zh: 许多国家希望减少电力消费，因为近年来电力需求持续增长。价格管制是短期内控制电力需求的常用手段。然而，即使价格管制能够减少用电量，电力需求的下降也会导致经济活动减弱，因为电力是重要的投入要素之一。有鉴于此，本研究分析电价变化如何影响电力需求，以及随之而来的电力需求变化如何改变制造业产出，并特别关注这些关系在空间上的变化。本文采用基于广义空间两阶段最小二乘法（GS2SLS）的联立方程模型，考察电力需求、经济产出与电价之间的相互关系。通过在同一个建模框架中评估这些关系，我们对电价情景进行了评估，以帮助政策制定者做出电价决策。

title: Exploring tax-based payment approach for forest carbon sequestration
abstract: We seek to determine if the tax-based payment approach is a valid alternative to existing incentive payment approaches for forest carbon sequestration. To achieve the objective, we test a hypothesis that waiving the property tax rate on forestland provides incentives to landowners for afforesting non-forested land or sustaining forests at risk of deforestation. We used a land use change model based on the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) 88 area as a case study to test the hypothesis. The estimated effects of the waived property tax on forestland from the land use model were then used to simulate changes in afforestation and deforestation under the current level of property tax rate and under the hypothetical zero property tax. The ex-ante forecasts were then used to estimate the amount of carbon sequestered using a carbon model. Finally the estimated carbon sequestrations under the two scenarios were applied to estimate costs of supplying carbon sequestration using the tax-based payment approach. We summarize our empirical results with two key findings. First, the results show that an increase in net return from forestland by waiving the property tax on forestland increases the shares of forestland, which in turn increases accumulation of carbon in the forest ecosystem. Second, our finding suggests that annualized cost of supplying forest-based carbon sequestration was estimated to be $101.48 per ton, should the tax-based payment approach be adopted in the BEA 88. On a per-ton basis, this cost is on the high end of the estimated cost of U.S. forest-based carbon sequestration ($30 to $90 per ton) in the previous literature. Despite its lower cost efficiency, the tax-based payment approach is still worth consideration because the administrative resources and systems needed for utilizing the property tax as a tool to internalize the positive externality of the carbon sequestration of forestland are already in place and thereby can avoid costs in creating complex new institutional arrangements associated with existing incentive payment approaches.
abstract_zh: 我们旨在判断基于税收的付费方式是否为现有森林碳封存激励性付费方式的有效替代方案。为此，我们检验了如下假设：免征林地财产税率能够激励土地所有者造林，或维持面临砍伐风险的森林。我们以美国经济分析局（BEA）88个区域为案例，利用土地利用变化模型检验该假设。随后，我们利用土地利用模型估计的林地免税效应，模拟了在现行财产税率水平和假设零财产税水平下的造林与砍伐变化。事前预测结果随后被用于通过碳模型估算碳封存量。最后，我们将两种情景下的碳封存估计量用于估算采用基于税收的付费方式提供碳封存的成本。本研究的实证结果可概括为两个主要发现。第一，免征林地财产税使林地净收益增加，进而提高了林地占比，并增加了森林生态系统中的碳积累。第二，我们的研究表明，如果在BEA 88区域采用基于税收的付费方式，森林碳封存的年化成本估计为每吨101.48美元。以每吨计，该成本处于先前文献中美国森林碳封存估计成本（每吨30至90美元）的高端。尽管成本效率较低，基于税收的付费方式仍值得考虑，因为利用财产税作为工具将林地碳封存的正外部性内部化所需的行政资源和制度体系已经存在，从而可以避免现有激励性付费方式所涉及的、创建复杂新制度安排的成本。

abstract: This research quantifies changes in consumer welfare due to changes in visitor satisfaction with the availability of information about recreational sites. The authors tested the hypothesis that an improvement in visitor satisfaction with recreation information increases the number of visits to national forests, resulting in increased consumer welfare. They tested the hypothesis with a travel cost model for the Allegheny National Forest using data from the National Visitor Use Monitoring (NVUM) programme. An ex ante simulation suggests that annual per capita consumer welfare increased when highly satisfactory recreation information was available. The findings, along with the expected costs of providing better recreation information, may be a useful reference for recreation site managers who wish to increase the number of visits in an economically effective way.

abstract: This study evaluates spatial variation in the relationship between agricultural output and input use across Turkey. The potential impact of the national agricultural policy reform introduced in 2001 on the spatial variation in agricultural output elasticities across the country was explored. By applying a spatial production function to the province-level data in 2000 and 2007, spatial heterogeneity in the variance of provincial total factor productivity and the input factor-output elasticities was identified across the country. Results show that the disparities in agricultural activities and geographic conditions affected return from input factors. Empirical findings from a spatial spillover model also suggest that changes in the input factor-output elasticities varied significantly across Turkey between 2000 and 2007, after the policy reform. Results suggest that future policy reform that recognizes regional comparative advantage through understanding the geographic heterogeneity of the agricultural sector is important for enhancing Turkey's agricultural output.

abstract: The main objective of this research is to propose a data-driven approach to estimate the amenity values of restoring urban forest landscapes at potential target sites. The approach allows establishing the overall price-driving time relationship between the amenity values attributable to both deforested and forested areas and their proximities to housing locations within a given community. Establishing the overall price-driving time relationship is important because the hedonic price model cannot be used to estimate the amenity values of yet to be restored urban forest landscapes that do not exist at the time of housing sales transactions. We estimated the sum of the differences between amenity values of deforested and forested areas on housing prices across different proximities to a potential restoration site. It can be viewed as a proxy for the value added to nearby houses resulting from a given urban forest restoration project at a potential target site.

title: EFFECT OF FORESTLAND AVAILABILITY BY OWNERSHIP TYPE ON LICENSE SALES FOR HUNTING: A SPATIAL APPROACH
abstract: The effect of forestland availability under different ownership types on license sales for hunting in nine Southeastern states is empirically evaluated. An equation that represents license sales for hunting is estimated assuming the sale of hunting licenses in a particular county is related to the characteristics of that county as well as the characteristics and license sales for hunting in its neighboring counties. The positive effects of the amounts of both national and private forestland on license sales reaffirm the potential benefits of maintaining forestland to stimulate hunting. The positive spillover effect of national forests on license sales for hunting suggests that availability and close access to hunting in national forests within neighboring counties are important in supporting hunting license sales in a county. This study contributes to the general understanding of the drivers affecting individuals’ decisions to use natural resources for hunting. Advances in natural resource modeling, specifically the spatial process model and geospatial data used in this research, make it possible to examine the interactions between the spatial dynamics and ownership attributes of the natural system, allowing policy makers to design natural resource management practices that respond to a system characterized by these interactions.
abstract_zh: 本文实证评估了东南部九个州中，不同所有权类型的林地可获得性对狩猎许可证销售的影响。我们估计了狩猎许可证销售方程，假设某县的狩猎许可证销售与该县的特征以及相邻县的特征和狩猎许可证销售相关。国有林地和私有林地数量的增加均对许可证销售产生正向影响，这再次印证了维持林地以促进狩猎的潜在效益。相邻县内国有林地的正向溢出效应表明，相邻县内国有林地的可获得性及其便利的狩猎通道，对于支持本县狩猎许可证销售具有重要作用。本研究有助于深化对影响个人利用自然资源进行狩猎决策之因素的整体理解。空间过程模型和本研究所使用的地理空间数据的进步，使得考察自然系统的空间动态与所有权属性之间的相互作用成为可能，从而使决策者能够设计出适应这种相互作用系统特征的自然资源管理措施。

abstract: This research analyzed the effects of forestland conversion from private to public ownership on greenhouse gas emissions by quantifying the relationship between forestland ownership conversion and deforestation, and then examining the effects of the change in deforestation on greenhouse gas emissions in South Korea. Ex ante simulations forecast greenhouse gas emissions resulting from deforestation rates under the current level of national forestland and three scenarios of increased percentages of national forestland. The findings suggest that increasing the percentage of national forestland would mitigate the increase in the deforestation rate, which in turn would moderate the increase in greenhouse gas emissions.

abstract: The environmental impacts of trade liberalization have stimulated considerable discussion in recent decades (Grossman and Krueger 1993; Antweiler, Copeland and Taylor 1998; Frankel 2009). Despite the substantial body of literature that has analyzed the impact of trade liberalization on the environment, because the empirical evidence is split there is no clear consensus on whether trade openness leads to an adverse impact on the environment. Thus, the accelerated development of regional and international trade agreements over the past decade has generated increasing concern over international trade’s potential negative environmental consequences, e.g. greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，贸易自由化的环境影响引发了广泛讨论（Grossman and Krueger 1993；Antweiler, Copeland and Taylor 1998；Frankel 2009）。尽管已有大量文献分析贸易自由化对环境的影响，但由于实证证据存在分歧，关于贸易开放是否会对环境造成不利影响，目前尚无明确共识。因此，过去十年间区域和国际贸易协定的加速发展，引发了人们对国际贸易可能带来的负面环境后果（例如温室气体（GHG）排放）日益增长的担忧。

abstract: This research suggests that consumers' marginal willingness to pay for environmental landscape attributes, such as water view, developed open space and forest-land open space, decreased during the 2008 recession compared to the 2000–2006 real estate boom. Estimates were obtained from a spatial hedonic housing price model after controlling for household location patterns and structural differences between the periods. Because the decline in amenity values was probably due to a temporary deterioration in economic conditions, the amenity values will probably rebound with economic recovery. Thus, development decisions based on the lower estimated amenity values measured during a temporary deterioration in economic conditions may be determined suboptimal post-economic recovery.
abstract_zh: 本研究表明，与2000至2006年房地产繁荣期相比，2008年经济衰退期间，消费者对水景、已开发开放空间以及林地开放空间等环境景观属性的边际支付意愿有所下降。估计结果来自空间特征价格住房模型，并在控制了家庭区位格局以及两个时期的结构性差异之后得出。由于舒适性价值的下降很可能源于经济状况的暂时恶化，因此随着经济复苏，舒适性价值有可能回升。因此，基于经济状况暂时恶化期间所测得的较低舒适性价值而作出的开发决策，在经济复苏后可能被证明是次优的。

title: Assessing the Spatial and Temporal Variation of Output-Input Elasticities of Agricultural Production in Turkey
abstract: This study evaluates the impacts of the Agricultural Reform Implementation Project (ARIP) on Turkey’s agricultural sector. Using a Turkish province-level data, we estimated an agricultural production function incorporating with a spatially heterogeneous error component to generate the output elasticities with respect to various inputs. This geographically weighted regression model (GWR-SEM) analyzes spatial variation of output-input elasticities and identifies the clusters of high output-input elasticities before and after the implementation of ARIP. Results suggest that the output elasticities with respect to inputs generally improved across the country in the post-ARIP period.
abstract_zh: 本研究评估了农业改革实施项目（ARIP）对土耳其农业部门的影响。我们利用土耳其省级数据，估计了一个包含空间异质性误差成分的农业生产函数，以得出产出对各类投入的弹性。该地理加权回归模型（GWR-SEM）分析了产出-投入弹性的空间变化，并识别了ARIP实施前后产出-投入弹性较高的聚类。结果表明，在ARIP实施后时期，全国各地产出对投入的弹性总体上有所改善。

abstract: This research note examined the performance of Geographically Weighted Regression (GWR) using two calibration methods. The first method, Cross Validation (CV), has been commonly used in the applied literature using GWR. A second criterion selected an optimal bandwidth that corresponded with the smallest spatial error Lagrange Multiplier (LM) test statistic. We find that there is a tradeoff between addressing spatial autocorrelation and reducing degree of extreme coefficients in GWR. Although spatial autocorrelation can be controlled for by using the LM criterion, a substantial degree of extreme coefficients may remain. However, while the CV approach appears to be less prone to producing extreme coefficients, it may not always attend to the problems that arise in the presence of spatial error autocorrelation.
abstract_zh: 本研究简报考察了采用两种校准方法时地理加权回归（GWR）的表现。第一种方法是交叉验证（CV），它在应用类GWR文献中被普遍采用。第二种准则选择使空间误差拉格朗日乘数（LM）检验统计量最小的最优带宽。我们发现，在GWR中处理空间自相关与降低极端系数程度之间存在权衡。虽然采用LM准则可以控制空间自相关，但仍可能存在大量极端系数。而CV方法虽然较少产生极端系数，但在存在空间误差自相关时，未必能解决相关问题。

abstract: This study applies a hedonic model to assess the economic benefits of air quality improvement following the 1990 Clean Air Act Amendment at the county level in the lower 48 United States. An instrumental variable approach that combines geographically weighted regression and spatial autoregression methods (GWR-SEM) is adopted to simultaneously account for spatial heterogeneity and spatial autocorrelation. SEM mitigates spatial dependency while GWR addresses spatial heterogeneity by allowing response coefficients to vary across observations. Positive amenity values of improved air quality are found in four major clusters: (1) in East Kentucky and most of Georgia around the Southern Appalachian area; (2) in a few counties in Illinois; (3) on the border of Oklahoma and Kansas, on the border of Kansas and Nebraska, and in east Texas; and (4) in a few counties in Montana. Clusters of significant positive amenity values may exist because of a combination of intense air pollution and consumer awareness of diminishing air quality.
abstract_zh: 本研究应用特征价格模型，评估了1990年《清洁空气法修正案》实施后，美国本土48州县级空气质量改善所带来的经济效益。我们采用一种结合地理加权回归与空间自回归方法（GWR-SEM）的工具变量方法，以同时处理空间异质性和空间自相关。空间误差模型（SEM）可缓解空间依赖性，而地理加权回归（GWR）则通过允许响应系数随观测值变化来处理空间异质性。研究发现，空气质量改善的正向舒适性价值集中于四个主要聚类：（1）肯塔基州东部和佐治亚州大部分地区，即南阿巴拉契亚地区；（2）伊利诺伊州的若干县；（3）俄克拉荷马州与堪萨斯州交界处、堪萨斯州与内布拉斯加州交界处，以及得克萨斯州东部；（4）蒙大拿州的若干县。显著正向舒适性价值的聚类，可能源于严重的空气污染与消费者对空气质量下降的认知相结合。

abstract: This paper applies recent developments in forecasting spatial process models to estimate the impact of input shocks on China‘s 1999 gross value added output (GVAO) in agriculture. A Cobb-Douglas production function allowing total factor productivity to vary across regions is used to forecast the geographic distribution of GVAO following shocks in input availability. Results suggest that GVAO will be similar to baseline levels following input shocks, but the differential gains experienced in some areas may correspond with losses in neighboring administrative units.
abstract_zh: 本文应用空间过程模型预测方面的最新进展，估计了投入冲击对中国1999年农业总增加值产出（GVAO）的影响。我们使用允许全要素生产率随地区变化的柯布-道格拉斯生产函数，预测投入供给冲击后GVAO的地理分布。结果表明，投入冲击后GVAO将接近基准水平，但某些地区获得的差额收益可能与相邻行政单元的损失相对应。

abstract: This study compares an ordered probit model and a Tobit model with selection to take into account both true zero and protest zero bids while estimating the willingness to pay (WTP) for conservation easements in Macon County, NC. By comparing the two models, the ordered/unordered selection issue of the protest responses is analyzed to demonstrate how the treatment of protest responses can significantly influence WTP models. Both models consistently show that income and knowledge are positive and significant factors, while distance to poorer quality streams and duration of residency are negative and significant factors on WTP.
abstract_zh: 本研究比较了有序概率模型与带选择的Tobit模型，以同时考虑真实零报价和抗议性零报价，从而估计北卡罗来纳州梅肯县土地保护地役权的支付意愿（WTP）。通过比较这两个模型，我们分析了抗议性回应的有序/无序选择问题，以说明对抗议性回应的处理方式如何显著影响支付意愿模型。两个模型一致表明，收入和相关知识是显著的正向因素，而与水质较差溪流的距离和居住年限则是显著的负向因素。

title: Spatial structure of agricultural production in China
abstract: The spatial structure of county-level agricultural production in China in 1999 is analysed. A convenient simple method that corrects for both spatial autocorrelation and spatial heterogeneity in the input–output relationships using spatial lag models and an allowance for the response coefficients to vary across relatively homogeneous regions are described. Empirical results suggest an abundant labour supply and extensive use of agricultural machinery reflected in its declining price. Although mechanization is relatively new, machines have replaced fertilizer in agricultural production in the North, Northeast, Northwest and East regions while irrigation and fertilizer are the significantly important inputs in the Central and Southwest regions.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了1999年中国县级农业生产的空间结构。文中描述了一种简便的方法：利用空间滞后模型校正投入产出关系中的空间自相关和空间异质性，并允许响应系数在相对同质的地区之间变化。实证结果表明，劳动力供给充裕，农业机械使用广泛，其价格下降即为体现。尽管机械化较新，但在华北、东北、西北和华东地区，机器已取代化肥成为农业生产的投入要素，而在华中和西南地区，灌溉和化肥则是显著重要的投入要素。

abstract: An agricultural production function is estimated using a Chinese county-level dataset along with associated geographic information. County-specific output-input elasticities are computed using the geographically weighted regression (GWR) and mapped with the geographical information system (GIS). A comparison of the ordinary least squares and GWR estimates confirms that allowing spatial variation in the parameters improves model fit of the agricultural production function, and provides valuable insights into the relative importance of inputs in different regions. Moran's indices reveal the spatial dependence of output per unit of land, and four inputs across regions. Mappings of GWR estimates help to detect a few clusters of high output-input elasticities: for labour in the Northeast, North, Southwest and Northwest China, for land in the Central and Southwest, for mechanical power in the North, Northwest and coastal area of the East and South and for fertiliser in the East. The county-specific scale elasticities suggest constant return to scale is likely to hold in the Central, East, Southwest and South.
abstract_zh: 本文利用中国县级数据及相关地理信息，估计了农业生产函数。我们采用地理加权回归（GWR）计算县级产出-投入弹性，并利用地理信息系统（GIS）进行制图。普通最小二乘法与GWR估计结果的比较证实，允许参数存在空间变化能够改善农业生产函数的拟合优度，并为不同地区各投入要素的相对重要性提供了有价值的见解。Moran指数揭示了单位土地产出以及四种投入要素在各地区之间的空间依赖性。GWR估计结果的制图有助于识别若干产出-投入弹性较高的聚类：劳动力在东北、华北、西南和西北地区，土地在华中和西南地区，机械动力在华北、西北以及华东和华南沿海地区，化肥在华东地区。县级规模弹性表明，华中、华东、西南和华南地区很可能符合规模报酬不变。

abstract: Much research has focused on the development of equilibrium models of local jurisdictions to analyze the formation of social structures and community characteristics. These models, however, have been subjected to little empirical testing. In a recent paper, Epple and Sieg (1999) developed a new method for estimating equilibrium models of local jurisdictions, but they did not include environmental amenities in their empirical application. In this paper, we extend and apply this new method to estimate households’ preferences for alternative environmental amenities in the Portland Oregon metropolitan area. We show that estimated structural parameters would be biased if environmental amenities are ignored. By including amenities into the structural models of local jurisdictions, households’ preferences for alternative environmental amenities and public goods are estimated. Parameter values underlying households’ residential choices are uncovered. Many of the empirical regularities observed in the data are replicated (JEL R1, R2, Q2).
abstract_zh: 大量研究致力于发展地方司法辖区的均衡模型，以分析社会结构和社区特征的形成。然而，这些模型很少经过实证检验。在Epple和Sieg（1999）的一篇近期论文中，作者提出了一种估计地方司法辖区均衡模型的新方法，但未将环境舒适性纳入其实证应用。本文扩展并应用这一新方法，估计俄勒冈州波特兰都市区家庭对不同环境舒适性的偏好。我们表明，若忽略环境舒适性，结构参数的估计将存在偏误。通过将舒适性纳入地方司法辖区的结构模型，我们估计了家庭对不同环境舒适性和公共物品的偏好，并揭示了支撑家庭居住选择的参数值。模型复现了数据中观察到的许多经验规律（JEL R1, R2, Q2）。

title: Measuring Interactions among Urbanization, Land Use Regulations, and Public Finance
abstract: This article presents a polychotomous choice‐selectivity model to estimate the interactions among urbanization, land use regulations, and public finance in five western states (California, Idaho, Nevada, Oregon, and Washington). Land use regulations in these five states reduced the total developed area by an estimated 12.2% from 1982 to 1992, but increased housing prices between 1.3% and 4.7%, depending on the intensity of land use regulations in a county. Land use regulations also reduced public expenditure and property tax in the long run by 5.6% and 8.4%, respectively, but increased public expenditure and property tax in the short run by 9.8% and 12.6%.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个多分类选择-选择性模型，用于估计加利福尼亚州、爱达荷州、内华达州、俄勒冈州和华盛顿州五个西部州中城市化、土地利用管制与公共财政之间的相互作用。1982年至1992年间，这五个州的土地利用管制使开发总面积减少了约12.2%，但根据各县管制强度的不同，住房价格上涨了1.3%至4.7%。土地利用管制还使公共支出和财产税在长期内分别减少了5.6%和8.4%，但在短期内分别增加了9.8%和12.6%。

abstract: This paper examines equilibrium properties of local jurisdictions implied by the Tiebout-style model. A set of equilibrium conditions are derived from a general equilibrium model of local jurisdictions. The conditions are parameterized and empirically estimated in a two-stage procedure. The method is applied to communities in a Portland metropolitan area with an extension of public-good provision to include environmental amenities. The results suggest that the model can replicate many of the empirical regularities observed in the data. For example, the predicted income distributions across communities closely matched the observed distribution. The estimated income elasticity of housing demand is consistent with previous findings. One important finding of this paper is that the parameter estimates would be biased if environmental amenities are not considered.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了蒂布特式模型所隐含的地方司法辖区的均衡性质。我们从地方司法辖区的一般均衡模型中推导出一组均衡条件。这些条件经过参数化，并通过两阶段程序进行实证估计。该方法应用于俄勒冈州波特兰都市区的社区，并将公共物品供给扩展至包括环境舒适性。结果表明，该模型能够复现数据中观察到的许多经验规律。例如，预测的社区收入分布与观察到的分布高度吻合。估计得出的住房需求收入弹性与以往研究结果一致。本文的一个重要发现是，若不考虑环境舒适性，参数估计将存在偏误。

MEASURING INTERACTIONS AMONG URBAN DEVELOPMENT, LAND USE REGULATIONS, AND PUBLIC FINANCE
abstract: In this paper, a theoretical model is developed to analyze the interactions among residential development, land use regulations, and public financial impacts (public expenditure and property tax). A simultaneous equations system with self-selection and discrete dependent variables is estimated to determine the interactions for counties in the five western states (California, Idaho, Nevada, Oregon, and Washington). The results show that county governments are more likely to impose land use regulations when facing rapid land development, high public expenditure and property tax. The land use regulations, in turn, decrease land development, long-run public expenditure, and property tax at the cost of higher housing prices and property tax. During the period of 1982-1992, land use regulations reduced developed areas by 612,800 acres or 8.8 % of the developed area of five western states in 1992, but increased housing price by $5,741 per unit under "stringent" regulations and $1,319 per unit under "low" regulations. Because it costs money to develop and implement land use regulations, land use regulations increased public expenditure and property tax in the short run, during the period of 1982-1987. However, in the long-run (1982-1992), land use regulations actually reduce public expenditure and property taxes because the regulations reduce developed areas. The results also show that land use regulations, land development, public expenditure, and property tax all are significantly affected by population, geographic location, land quality, housing prices, and the risks and costs of development.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个理论模型，用于分析住宅开发、土地利用管制与公共财务影响（公共支出和财产税）之间的相互作用。我们对美国五个西部州（加利福尼亚州、爱达荷州、内华达州、俄勒冈州和华盛顿州）的各县，估计了一个包含自选择和离散因变量的联立方程系统，以确定其相互作用。结果表明，当面临快速土地开发、高公共支出和高财产税时，县政府更有可能实施土地利用管制。土地利用管制反过来又以更高的住房价格和财产税为代价，减少了土地开发、长期公共支出和财产税。1982年至1992年间，土地利用管制使开发面积减少了612,800英亩，相当于1992年五个西部州开发面积的8.8%，但在“严格”管制下每单位住房价格上涨5,741美元，在“低度”管制下上涨1,319美元。由于制定和实施土地利用管制需要花费资金，在1982年至1987年的短期内，土地利用管制增加了公共支出和财产税。然而，从长期（1982年至1992年）来看，土地利用管制实际上减少了公共支出和财产税，因为管制减少了开发面积。结果还表明，土地利用管制、土地开发、公共支出和财产税均显著受到人口、地理位置、土地质量、住房价格以及开发风险与成本的影响。
